title: 日本ダービーの後に・現実の高度差

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa is supposed to be the strongest in the world. However, she faces a shocking defeat at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Doubting her abilities, she begins to worry she won't be able to spread her wings for the world and advance confidently to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, I decide that El Condor Pasa needs some time to get her thoughts in order.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest running in the Mainichi Okan before taking on the Japan Cup.
